description: Use this when someone asks to book an animal in for a visit at their vet clinic. Returns the new appointment with its time, provider ids and procedure count; it takes the clinic's usual length and reminders, so the clinic's reminder messages go to the animal's owner. Not for vaccinations, which are booked in Veterical.

clinicId.description: Id of the clinic, from list_clinics. Leave it out when the user has one clinic.

durationMinutes.description: Length in minutes. Leave it out for the clinic's usual appointment length.

patientId.description: Id of the animal, from find_patient or create_patient. It needs an owner on file.

procedureIds.description: Ids of the procedures booked, from list_procedures. A vaccine is refused.

providerIds.description: Ids of the vets, nurses or assistants who take it, from list_clinic_providers. Leave it out when the clinic has one or the user takes appointments.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this booking, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first booking rather than booking twice.

startTime.description: Start as an ISO 8601 time with the clinic's UTC offset, such as 2026-11-20T10:00:00+01:00.

name: book_appointment
title: Book a vet appointment
